t: Detect stale in_progress lugs at wakeup — warn when unchanged for 4+ hours, offer abandon/resume/extend
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai.md Step 4 (Load Active Lugs) — how in_progress lugs are loaded. 2. ls WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/*/in_progress/*.json — check what in_progress lugs exist and their timestamps. 3. Check lug schema for updated_at / ua field.
execute: 1. Add to wai.md Step 7 (after loading active lugs): for each in_progress lug, check ua (updated_at) or file mtime. 2. If older than 4 hours: surface warning: '{lug_id} has been in_progress for {N}h. Mark abandoned / Resume / Extend deadline?' 3. User response: 'abandon' moves to open/ with note; 'resume' continues; 'extend' updates ua. 4. Sync wai.md to all targets.
verify: 1. Create a lug in in_progress/ with ua older than 4h — wakeup shows warning. 2. Fresh in_progress lug (ua within 4h) — no warning. 3. Abandon action moves lug back to open/ with review_reason set.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Stale in_progress lug detection at wakeup with user choice to abandon/resume/extend
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not auto-abandoning — always asks user. The 4h threshold is for warning only.
